description: This file defines the EditView2 class used in the SuiteCRM project, responsible for handling the rendering and processing of the edit view UI, including form generation, field population, and template rendering within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: EditView
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the display, processing, and rendering of the edit view form in SuiteCRM, including field handling, template rendering, and user interaction logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the EditView object, loads metadata and template files, and prepares the form for rendering.

methods.name: createFocus
methods.description: Creates a new bean focus object for the current module if none exists.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Populates the focus bean with data from the request or other sources.

methods.name: requiredFirst
methods.description: Ensures required fields are displayed in the first panels.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Prepares the view data and renders the edit form template.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Prepares the form for display, handles request parameters, and manages form state.

methods.name: insertJavascript
methods.description: Inserts custom JavaScript into the view.

methods.name: callFunction
methods.description: Calls a user-defined function specified in field definitions.

methods.name: getValueFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts and unformats a value from the request array.

methods.name: showTitle
methods.description: Returns the module title for display purposes.

methods.name: getTemplateHandler
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the TemplateHandler.
